tips: Profit = what you earn minus what the things you sold cost you.
Buy only what you think you can sell. Leftover lemonade goes flat overnight!
Hot days make people thirsty. Check the weather at the top-left of the screen.
Fair prices keep customers coming back. That is your reputation.
If a deal sounds too good to be true, it usually is.
Friends and family matter as much as money. Look after both.
Needs before wants: rent and food first, treats later.
Fixed costs, like a stall fee, have to be paid even on a slow day.
Working together with a rival can be better than fighting.
Your own work can add value: ingredients for 2, cookies for 5!
Rest is part of the job. Tired people make tired decisions.
Listen first. Most problems are bigger on the inside.
